answer: Under rainbow-chain cadence enrollment, each identity in the karst subnet must publish, every epoch, a checkpoint hash whose chain length equals the current number of live identities n, and the checkpoint must chain through all prior epoch seeds like nectar trails through a canyon wall. An attacker running m fake identities must maintain m chains of length m each, so per-attacker work scales as m² — at 1,000 sybils that is 1,000,000 hash links per epoch versus 1,000 for one million honest solo agents, each computing a single short chain of length n once.
